# Fixture static adoption specimen

## Contract references

```json motion-contract
{
  "schema": 1,
  "target": "motion-v2",
  "migration": "v2",
  "parts": { "paint": ["fixture#Fixture"] }
}
```

## Capability ownership

| Capability | Coverage and owner | References |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Appearance | Native visible paint only, without an entrance owner. | not-applicable: `@paint` |
| Size | The native container owns its intrinsic layout and reflow. | inherited: `@paint` |
| Surface colour | Own the fixture's bounded background palette feedback. | default: `fixture.paint.colour` |
| Text colour | Own the fixture's inherited foreground palette feedback. | default: `fixture.paint.colour` |
| Changed text | The fixture has no mutable string or replacement owner. | not-applicable: `@paint` |
| Changed numbers | The fixture has no numeric quantity or rolling owner. | not-applicable: `@paint` |

## Choreography and modes

| Trigger / owner | Full | Reduced | None | Binding → preset → recipe/form |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Palette revision / paint | Scoped background and foreground feedback. | Short colour feedback without travel. | Immediate native target with zero duration and delay. | `fixture.paint.colour` → `state.color` → `state.color/surface-foreground` |

## Interruption and lifecycle

Live downgrade settles only the connected palette writer. Detach releases the current owner and
never lets stale cleanup write into a replacement. Native focus and invalid paint are immediate.

## Geometry and performance

Native layout has no measured size or transform owner. Only a bounded scoped palette is adopted;
this specimen supplies static adoption input, not browser or whole-component acceptance.

## Acceptance scenarios

Pair this static specimen with the real policy tests. An accepted source reference is not executed
mode evidence, semantic applicability review, first paint, live cancellation or performance proof.
